attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a Kea DHCP server on the private eth1 network (10.50.50.0/24, gateway 10.50.50.254, pool .100-.200), and configured node2/node3 (Alpine) eth1 interfaces to obtain addresses via DHCP instead of static assignment. Both nodes successfully leased addresses (node2=10.50.50.100, node3=10.50.50.101) from node1. Completed the mandatory sequential single-node restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery.
